name: building-equity-valuation-models
description: Builds and reviews equity valuation models: DCF on unlevered free cash flow at WACC with relevered beta; Gordon growth and exit multiple terminal values with implied multiple and growth checks; mid-year convention, stub periods; trading comparables (LTM, NTM) and precedent transactions with control premium or discount for lack of control; the enterprise value to equity value bridge (debt, ASC 842 leases, preferred, noncontrolling interests, pensions, trapped cash); diluted shares (treasury stock method, convertibles); stock-based compensation; football field, sensitivities. States the standard of value (ASC 820 fair value, fair market value, investment value, statutory fair value). Use for DCF, comps, precedents, price targets, value per share, WACC, terminal value, net debt bridge, fair market value of closely held interests with DLOC and DLOM, DCF and comparables used to support the exit multiple in an LBO, or valuation model outputs behind an investment committee memo. Drafts for qualified review.
